decision: Take Metro Line 2 to Lujiazui if it is operating.
steps: Follow the signs to the Pudong Airport Metro station, confirm Line 2 service to Lujiazui and ask a staffed counter which non-QR options it accepts before entering.
Follow signs to Metro Line 2. The SWFC access map shows Lujiazui Exit 6 and about 600 m along Century Avenue to No. 100. Use current station signs.
Use the Park Hyatt / Shanghai World Financial Center address, not Grand Hyatt / Jin Mao Tower. The properties have different entrances and street numbers.

fallbacks.when: Rail or payment at the gate fails
fallbacks.action: Ask the staffed counter about a physical ticket and acceptable payment. If rail is unsuitable, use the official T1 taxi rank near Arrivals Gate 12.

fallbacks.when: Your flight arrives at T2 instead
fallbacks.action: Follow the signs for your actual terminal. At T2 the official arrivals taxi rank is at Gate 25, not the T1 gate.
Ask the airport's staffed service desk about transport options before boarding. Don't assume an overseas card is accepted.

preferencePlans.no_mobile_data: Save this PDF and the Chinese card to your phone before boarding.
preferencePlans.no_mobile_payments: Ask the staffed counter or taxi dispatcher about cash and physical cards. Carry a cash fallback if possible.

checklist: Save the Chinese address and check the hotel name against your reservation.
Recheck the operating flight, terminal and rail service before you leave.
boundary: This QA example uses a fictional flight. Transport can change; fares, card acceptance and accessible exits are not guaranteed.
